messages:
natalie: Thinking out loud — propose 'indexed checkpoints' for sideloads: split large airgap payloads into index + checkpoint layers, apply checkpoints in order and support idempotent resume + compact rollback markers. Goals: minimize operator friction, allow resume after failed apply, and keep offline signature verification cheap.

sam: +1. how different from current seed+delta? main ask is operator UX and not re-downloading whole seed.

prateek: Key idea: store a small immutable index (manifest) that's signed. Then transfer deltas referencing indices. On apply, operator streams only needed blobs. Rollback: we keep an activation fence pointer and tombstones so operator can fast-swap previous activation.

jin: UX q: if operator aborts mid-apply, do we require a full rehydrate or can we replay from last checkpoint? Suggest designing checkpoints as idempotent checkpoints with per-component txn boundaries.

natalie: Exactly — checkpoints are per-component (kernel, model shards, config). Each checkpoint has: hash, size, signature, deps. On resume we reconcile using local cache + index; only fetch missing blobs.

sre-bot: CI artifact build: sideload-index prototype builds ok. test coverage: offline-apply-resume passed 12/14 tests, failing flaky Δ-apply ordering.

sam: Concern: operator network constraints — need ability to prefetch or allow 'best-effort' partial-apply with clear operator prompts. Also telemetry for partial success counts.

prateek: Security: KMS/HSM integration — manifest signatures must be verifiable offline. Use detached signatures and include chain-of-trust anchors in index.

jin: Also need clear rollback hooks in operator: `rbd activate --rollback-to <marker>` or via k8s annotation. Keep commands tiny.

natalie: Draft manifest example:
```
index_v1:
 - component: model-shard-000
   hash: sha256:abcd...
   size: 12GB
   sig: sig1
 - component: runtime-bin
   hash: sha256:1234...
   size: 120MB
   sig: sig2
activation_marker: sha256:abcd...@2026-03-20
```

sam: Nice. pls add TTL and operator confirmation semantics. Also add a 'prune' policy to GC old checkpoints safely.

prateek: Implementation note: runtime should support 'sideload mount' mapping: blobs -> loopback so we can swap in new model files without container restart.

natalie: Next steps: create short RFC (1-pager) with operator CLI examples, manifest schema v0, and fallout tests. Volunteers for prototype: @prateek, @sam.

sam: I can take CLI ergonomics + UX docs.

prateek: I'll wire prototype for manifest signing + resume logic.

jin: I'll own operator rollback API and k8s annotations.

natalie: Nice. tagging eng-oncall to watch for any rollout issues when we dogfood: @eng-oncall :eyes:

sre-bot: noted — will schedule canary test in staging on 2026-03-22.

sam: Cool. One more ask: add metric for 'bytes avoided by resume' so we can measure economic impact.

natalie: Added to TODOs. closing thread for now — will post RFC link when ready :rocket:
